description: USOS_SOL.Fluvialitat is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.pre.intranet.gencat.cat. La cobertura identifica i descriu els hàbitats presents en els àmbits fluvials segons les 3 categories que estableix el projecte europeu Corine Land Cover (CLC) mitjançant fotointerpretació i validació al camp, Amb aquesta finalitat aquesta cobertura actualitza i detalla els hàbitats de l'espai fluvial dels rius de Catalunya a una escala de representació 1:5.000 sobre ... Coverage: ES. The listing shows 2011-11-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
